tasks.label: Zuke: Refresh Profile Locks
tasks.detail: Refreshes locks for a specific example project and scope (mutating; All profiles uses an explicit --all-profiles flag).

tasks.label: Zuke: Verify Profile Locks (No Mutation)
tasks.detail: Verifies all profile locks in the selected project without mutating them.

tasks.label: Zuke: Run All Specification Gates (zuke:gate:all)
tasks.detail: Runs validation, test execution, and lock verification across calculator, shopping cart, and todo examples.

tasks.label: Zuke: Run Repository Check Suite (zuke:check)
tasks.detail: Runs format check, doc check, analysis, unit/widget tests, generation check, and spec gates.

tasks.label: Melos: Run All Tests (test:all)
tasks.detail: Runs pure Dart tests and Flutter widget tests across all packages and examples.

tasks.label: Melos: Analyze Workspace (analyze:all)
tasks.detail: Runs dart analyze across SDK packages and flutter analyze across example apps.

tasks.label: Zuke: Generate Contracts (zuke:generate)
tasks.detail: Generates contract code from Gherkin feature specifications.

tasks.label: Zuke: Check Version Alignment
tasks.detail: Checks supported Zuke dependency alignment for the selected project.

tasks.label: Zuke: Doctor Check
tasks.detail: Diagnoses project setup for the selected project.

tasks.label: Zuke: Doctor Test Host Compatibility
tasks.detail: Explains Flutter/test SDK compatibility for the selected project.

tasks.label: Melos: Coverage Check (coverage:check)
tasks.detail: Runs clean LCOV coverage collection and verifies coverage thresholds.

tasks.label: Melos: Workspace Bootstrap
tasks.detail: Runs pub get and connects workspace members using Dart Pub Workspaces.

inputs.description: Select profile scope to refresh (All profiles or one configured profile)
